newsHighlights.title: Warm meals and shelter for quake-hit areas
newsHighlights.summary: Temporary housing units have been rushed in from Lhasa to provide warm meals and shelter for people affected by the magnitude-7.0 earthquake in Nagqu, Xizang.
newsHighlights.translation: 为西藏那曲地震灾区送去热饭和住所：大批临时安置房从拉萨紧急运抵灾区，为受灾群众提供热食和栖身之所。

newsHighlights.title: Relief efforts intensify after Xizang quake kills 16, injures 76
newsHighlights.summary: Relief work has been stepped up across Xizang after the magnitude-7.0 earthquake killed 16 people and injured 76 others.
newsHighlights.translation: 西藏地震致16人遇难、76人受伤，救援工作全面加强。

newsHighlights.title: Xizang quake relief steps up to keep survivors warm
newsHighlights.summary: Workers distributed blankets, heating equipment and hot food to keep survivors warm as night temperatures dropped sharply on the plateau.
newsHighlights.translation: 西藏地震救援加紧进行，向受灾群众发放棉被、取暖设备和热食，帮助幸存者抵御高原严寒。

newsHighlights.title: Kenya records second Ebola death as outbreak reaches nine cases
newsHighlights.summary: Kenya has confirmed a second Ebola death as the outbreak grows to nine cases, prompting tighter health screening at borders and in local communities.
newsHighlights.translation: 肯尼亚埃博拉疫情已累计9例病例、2人死亡，当地加强了边境和社区的卫生筛查。

newsHighlights.title: China's snow leopard population doubles
newsHighlights.summary: Thanks to decades of conservation work, China's snow leopard population has doubled, making the country home to the largest number of the endangered cats in the world.
newsHighlights.translation: 经过数十年的保护努力，中国雪豹种群数量翻倍，成为全球雪豹数量最多的国家。

quote.author: Virgil
quote.explanation: 这句拉丁诗人维吉尔的名言提醒我们：无论物质多么丰富，健康始终是生活中最宝贵的财富。今日新闻中灾区群众需要热饭、棉被和医疗救治，正说明在灾难与疾病面前，守护生命与健康永远是第一位的。

pattern.pattern: keep + 宾语 + 形容词（使……保持某种状态）
pattern.example: Xizang quake relief steps up to keep survivors warm.
pattern.translation: 西藏地震救援加紧进行，以使幸存者保持温暖。
pattern.usage: 该句型表示“使某人/某物保持某种状态”，形容词作宾语补足语。常见搭配如 keep the room clean（保持房间干净）、keep children healthy（让孩子保持健康）、keep food fresh（保持食物新鲜）。否定式为 keep sb. from doing sth.（阻止某人做某事），注意区分。

grammar.title: with 复合结构（with + 名词 + 现在分词）
grammar.explanation: 在英语新闻中，常用 "with + 宾语 + 现在分词" 构成独立主格结构，表示伴随状况或背景，相当于一个补充说明的状语从句。句中 with 后的名词与后面的动词是主动关系，因此用现在分词（-ing）形式。例如 "with workers racing to complete their..." 意为“工人们正争分夺秒地完成……”。若名词与动词是被动关系，则用过去分词（如 with the road blocked by snow）；若表状态，可用介词短语（如 with blankets in their hands）。
examples: Temporary housing units have been rushed in from Lhasa, with workers racing to complete their construction before nightfall.
Rescue teams worked around the clock, with medical staff treating the injured and checking on residents' health.

pronunciation.tips: 注意首音 /ʃ/ 与汉语“湿”相似但需扁唇送气；重音在第一音节 /ˈʃel-/，元音为短音 /e/，不要读成 /ʃeɪl/；词尾的 -ter 浊化成轻快的 /tər/，舌尖轻触上齿龈后迅速放开，不要读成清晰的“特”。整词节奏为“前重后轻”。
examples: The government built temporary shelter for the quake-hit families.
Warm meals and shelter were offered to everyone in need.

reading.title: Warmth on the Plateau: Health and Life After the Xizang Quake
reading.content: After a magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Drachen county in Nagqu, Xizang, on Oct 22, rescue and relief efforts have intensified across the region. The quake killed 16 people and injured 76 others, leaving many families without homes just as night temperatures dropped sharply on the plateau. Temporary housing units were rushed in from Lhasa, and workers raced against time to set up tents and provide warm meals and shelter for survivors. Medical teams treated the injured and checked on residents' health day and night, paying special attention to children and older people. Volunteers distributed blankets and heating equipment to keep everyone warm during the freezing nights. Doctors said that staying warm, eating hot food and getting enough rest are all important for people living in disaster areas. In Kenya, meanwhile, health workers are fighting another battle against the Ebola outbreak, reminding us that protecting public health is everyone's responsibility.
reading.translation: 10月22日，7.0级地震袭击西藏那曲巴青县后，全区救援与救灾工作不断加强。地震造成16人遇难、76人受伤，许多家庭失去住所，而高原夜间气温骤降。大批临时安置房从拉萨紧急运抵，工人们争分夺秒地搭建帐篷，为幸存者提供热饭和住所。医疗队昼夜不停地救治伤员、关注居民健康，尤其重视儿童和老人。志愿者发放棉被和取暖设备，帮助大家度过寒冷的夜晚。医生表示，保暖、吃热食、充分休息，对灾区群众都很重要。与此同时，在肯尼亚，医护人员正在抗击埃博拉疫情，这提醒我们：保护公共健康，人人有责。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 China Daily（Warm meals and shelter for quake-hit areas；Xi orders all-out rescue work in Xizang）及 CGTN（Xizang quake relief steps up to keep survivors warm；Relief efforts intensify after Xizang quake；Kenya records second Ebola death）2026年10月25日的报道改写，用词与句型已简化以适应英语学习者。
